name: APEFOODT (Asociación Peruana de Food Truck)
notes: Official Peruvian Food Truck Association based in Lima.

name: Asociación Mexicana de Food Trucks
notes: Founded around 2013 in Mexico City to legalize and represent 100+ food trucks; no active standalone official website or verified current email found in 2026 search.

name: Food Truck Center Chile
notes: Chilean food truck operator hub and municipal advisory group; contact via website form.

name: Hida Food Truck Association (飛騨フードトラック協会)
notes: Regional Japanese food truck association handling vendor memberships and event dispatches via their web contact form.

name: Truckat (تركّات)
notes: Saudi Arabian platform and vendor guide organizing food trucks/carts; explicitly lists Yahala@truckatsa.com for partnerships/sponsorships and TechSupport@truckatsa.com for support.

name: Turnup Food Truck SA
notes: South African food truck event booking and mobile vendor network covering Johannesburg

name: Asociación Argentina de Gastronomía Móvil (AsArGaM)
notes: Pushed the 2016 mobile gastronomy law; co-founded by Rodolfo Cámara (The Food Truck Store). Source: forbesargentina.com/liderazgo/food-trucks-negocio-sobre-ruedas-n376; cronista.com. Find current Facebook/Instagram.

name: Asociación Argentina de Food Trucks
notes: Led by Ernesto Lanusse (Nómade food truck); quoted in a 14-10-2026 Perfil article. Source: perfil.com (por-que-los-food-trucks-no-pueden-instalarse...). Contact via Nómade's social accounts.

name: Asociación Food Truck de la República Argentina (AFTRA)
notes: President Luis Defelipe (Food Truck Argentina). Source: infogastronomica.com.ar. Find social pages.

name: Associação Brasiliense de Food Trucks
notes: Named as technical supporter of a SEBRAE food truck guide (with Abrasel). Source: sebraen2.tel.inf.br PDF; bdm.unb.br theses. Find Instagram.

name: Associação Paranaense de Food Trucks (APFT)
notes: Listed in a 2016 UnB thesis. Source: bdm.unb.br/bitstream/10483/15987. May be inactive; check Instagram.

name: Associação de Food Trucks e Comida de Rua da Bahia
notes: President Gabriel Lobo (Guerrilha Truck) in 2015. Source: portal.sescsp.org.br. May be inactive.

name: Aso Food Trucks Bogotá
notes: President Luis Fernando Tobián; runs monthly Bogotá Food Truck Market / The Food Truck Park. Source: larepublica.co. Find social pages.

name: Asofoodtruck (Cali)
notes: Association lobbying Cali municipality. Source: elpais.com.co. Find social pages.

name: Asociación Ecuatoriana de Food Trucks (AEF)
notes: Legally constituted ~2016; Facebook page referenced. Source: peru-retail.com/food-trucks-conquistan-quito. Find Facebook page.

name: Asociación Mexicana de Food Trucks
notes: Founders Maricarmen Linares, Edgar Núñez, Bernardo Bukantz. Source: timeoutmexico.mx; expansion.mx. Likely dormant; check social.

name: Food Trucks DF
notes: President Fernando Reyes; created 2013. Source: chilango.com. Check social.

name: Asociación Internacional de Foodtrucks y Franquicias Móviles
notes: Opened HQ in Morelia. Source: chilango.com. Check social.
